parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: PageIndex
parameters.description: The first page to export. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The interface to which the protection rule applies. This parameter is mutually exclusive with the ResourceSearchKey parameter.

parameters.name: ResourceSearchKey
parameters.description: The interface keyword that you can search from protection rules. This parameter is mutually exclusive with the Resource parameter.
